name: events-occurrence-development-v3
provenance: synthetic, same seven v2 source articles; revised occurrence/development annotation contract
annotation_policy: An Event is one business occurrence across its lifetime. A Development is an update within it. Unconfirmed possible reopening attaches as pending_claim, not conflict or verified resolution. Event membership labels are unchanged from v2.
limitations: Correlated synthetic sequences, not a human-annotated real-news benchmark.
E-only evaluation with frozen W2 facts, review and duplicate labels; no upstream W2 quality claim.
Live mode measures models on these sources; mock mode tests orchestration only.
